WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    tally,
    SUM(tally) OVER () AS total_tally,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') AS status,
    tally,
    CAST(tally AS REAL) / total_tally AS share,
    1.0 / num_statuses AS average_share
  FROM with_totals
)
SELECT 
  status,
  tally,
  share,
  share - average_share AS above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY share DESC
